about_the_game:
WingWhiz is a fast paced arcade shooter packed with rogue-lite progression and bullet-hell action. Unlock new planes as you progress each with unique stats, weapons, and abilities. Dodge enemy fire and unleash bullets, rockets, and special attacks to tear enemies apart. All enemy NPCs can be physically destroyed, making every battle feel explosive and dynamic.

Each run is different, with randomized encounters, enemy patterns, and challenges. Fly through shifting worlds, face changing enemy types, and battle powerful bosses at the end of every act. The deeper you go, the harder it gets.

Between runs, collect coins and unlock permanent upgrades in the Hangar to prepare for your next attempt.

The sky keeps changing so must you.

Features

  • Unlock a variety of planes, each with unique stats and special abilities like dash or missiles.

  • Engage in fast paced, bullet hell combat where every enemy and object can be physically destroyed.

  • Experience roguelite progression with randomized encounters, hazards, and enemy patterns in every run.

  • Spend collected coins on permanent upgrades in the Hangar: boost fire rate, health, fuel capacity, and unlock global powerup perks.

  • Fight intense bosses at the end of each world to unlock new environments and challenges.

  • Explore multiple themed worlds like Desert, Underground, Ocean, Forest, and Space. Each with unique visuals, enemy types and bosses.

  • Build shoot combos and near miss streaks mid run to increase your fire power, score and rewards.

  • Designed for high replayability, with runs that evolve as your skills and upgrades grow.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 -or- AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU NVIDIA GTX 660 / 750 ti -or- AMD R7 260X (2 GB VRAM, DX11)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K -or- AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 3 GB -or- AMD RX 570 4 GB
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

short_description: You’re a combat aircraft fighting to survive in a chaos-ruled world where everything is against you. Upgrade your plane, secure power-ups, build combos, and tear apart anything in your way to unlock new worlds. Stay alive and show no mercy!
